Subject: Next steps & counsel status — FinBridge pilot redlines

Thanks again for the time today, Alyssa — great conversation and clear alignment on the pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

- Scope: 3-month pilot, 2 models (chat + embeddings) powering underwriting assist + internal search.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in manual review time on target cohort; <150ms median inference latency.
- Data: PII will be scoped to hashed identifiers only; customer data stays in agreed region.

Immediate asks/actions: 
1) Can you confirm who on your counsel/procurement side should receive contract redlines? We want to send directly to the right inbox.
2) Any specific compliance docs you need (SOC2, encryption, audit logs)? We can attach the SOC2 report snapshot if helpful.
3) Confirm target pilot start week (earliest available for us is 9/13).

I'll prepare our MSA redlines and target sending on Tue (Aug 4). If it helps, we can also offer a short call between your counsel and our legal to walk the redlines — we find that speeds things up.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
